title: 晚上，地球转过去了
subtitle: 太阳没有走，是我们转过去了
character: wearing light blue pajamas with a small star pattern, bare feet, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft chalk pastel painting, deep indigo night and warm cream palette, gentle grain, quiet glowing light
neg_extra: harsh light, daytime, bright saturated colors, scary darkness

pages.zh:
天黑了，该睡觉了。
我趴在窗台上问：
「太阳去哪里了？」
pages.scene: A little boy in pajamas kneeling at a bedroom window at night looking out at a deep blue sky, a small bedside lamp glowing warm behind him, cozy quiet room.

pages.zh:
太阳没有去哪里。
它一直在那儿，
一直亮着，
从来没有关过。
pages.scene: The sun shining steadily and calmly in deep space against a dark starry background, warm and quiet, gentle glow, not fiery or frightening.

pages.zh:
是我们——
慢慢地，
转过去了。
pages.scene: The Earth as a blue and green ball floating in dark space, one half lit by warm sunlight from the side, the other half in soft shadow, calm and gentle.

pages.zh:
我们住的地球，
是一个很大很大的球。
它一直在「转」。
转一圈，就是一天。
pages.scene: The Earth turning slowly in dark space with a soft curved arrow drawn around it showing the spin, stars behind, calm night colours, picture book style.

pages.zh:
转到有太阳的那一面——
就是白天。
转到背着太阳的那一面——
就是晚上。
pages.scene: One round Earth in space: on the sunlit side a small town in daylight, on the shadowed side a similar town at night with warm lit windows, the line between them soft and gradual.

pages.zh:
现在我们这边是晚上。
地球的另外一边，
有小朋友正在吃早饭呢。
pages.scene: Two children drawn small on the curve of the round Earth on opposite sides: one asleep in bed on the night side, one eating breakfast at a sunlit table on the day side, stars around the planet.

pages.zh:
你睡觉的时候，
地球也在转。
轻轻地，稳稳地，
一点声音都没有。
pages.scene: A little boy asleep in bed seen from above, moonlight falling across the blanket, everything very still and quiet, deep blue and cream tones.

pages.zh:
转啊转，
天边慢慢变亮了。
那不是太阳升起来，
是我们转回来了。
pages.scene: The curved horizon of the Earth seen from a little way above, the dark side slowly coming into light, a thin warm band of dawn along the curve, stars fading softly.

pages.zh:
早上，
第一缕光照在窗帘上。
我们又转到太阳这边了。
pages.scene: Warm morning light falling across a curtain in a child's bedroom, a little boy in pajamas just waking up, one bare foot out from under the blanket, soft and quiet.

pages.zh:
所以「晚安」的意思是：
我们转过去一会儿，
明天，
再转回来。
pages.scene: A little boy in pajamas lying in bed with his eyes closed and a small smile, the window behind him showing a night sky with a few stars, very peaceful, warm lamp light.
